$comment: Hand-maintained. The conferences npm run collect:end-user-talks snapshots into data/end-user-talks/<slug>.json, one entry each. `sourceUrl` is the human schedule, `apiUrl` the Sessionize feed, `sessionUrl` the deep link for one session with `{id}` in place of its Sessionize id, `utcOffset` the event-local offset Sessionize omits from its timestamps (keep it in step with the `timezone` label) and `select` the rule that picks the end user talks out of the feed: `{ category, item }` names the official Sessionize category when the conference has one, `{ sessionIds }` lists curated ids when it does not. `selection` is the phrase the schedule component shows for the rule. npm run validate:end-user-talks checks this file and every snapshot.
